info.name: Picklymart Admin API
info.description:
Versioned REST API for the Picklymart admin panel, generated from the live route list.

1. Run **Authentication > Sign in** — the bearer token is saved to the collection automatically.
2. Everything else is then authorized; just Send.
3. Sample ids are baked into the URLs — run a List request first and paste a real id.

request.description: Replace the sample id in the URL with a real one (run the List request first).

exec: console.log("Token saved to the collection automatically.");
